Figure 1 The overview of δ-mem. Given the hidden state from a frozen Transformer backbone, δ-mem first projects it into a low-dimensional memory space, and reads context-relevant associative memory signals from the previous online state, and uses the signal to generate low-rank corrections to the attention computation. After the computation, the memory state is updated with the current key-value information via delta-rule learning.
